family_members_validated_hard_fail_3: L-160 initiator: STR_1683 Distress+Calmar (signal IC 0.2207, ICIR 1.879, FM t=16.887 매우 강력 / portfolio MDD 94.66 SR -0.242)

motivation.problem_statement: signal-level IC/ICIR 지표는 portfolio-level alpha를 보장하지 않는다. 한국시장 long-only 20-stock 구현 단계에서 (a) publication decay, (b) concentration risk, (c) non-linear signal transformation 부재, (d) sector bias 등으로 수익화 실패. 5 supervisor-level gates (S0~S4 + Judge S6 existing 12 gates)로 탐지 불가.

gate_14_design_specification.gate_scope: S1 (Forge factor_engine + strategy 실행 후) + S6 (Judge Role Honesty Audit 동시)
gate_14_design_specification.enforcement_level: L3 hard_block (Admission Rule v3.5.2 mandatory addition 제안)
gate_14_design_specification.trigger_conditions:
hypothesis에 다음 중 하나라도 true일 때 gate 14 자동 활성화:
1. expected_role = defense OR core_secondary
2. signal_level_ICIR ≥ 0.5 OR signal_level_FM_t ≥ 3.0 declared in s0_record
3. factor_engine 내 single-axis composite weight ≥ 0.5 (Q07 0.7 weight 등)
4. S0 record lesson_check에 L-160 또는 L-165 reference 존재
5. sub_family에 'residual' / 'composite' / 'multi_source' 포함

measurement_protocol_5_step: Step 1: pre_cost_IC = monthly cross-section Spearman (portfolio weights based prediction vs realized next-month return)
Step 2: pre_cost_portfolio_return = Top 20 EW Long signal-based portfolio monthly return
sub_gate_14a_net_ic_transmission_ratio.hard_fail: ratio < 0.4 → L-160 decoupling 확정 → L-165 family 3rd member trigger → AX_CAND 3/3 promote 경고

sub_gate_14b_stress_portfolio_return_win.definition: 3개 stress window 중 portfolio return positive count
sub_gate_14b_stress_portfolio_return_win.hard_fail: 0 window positive → L-160 stress decoupling 확정

sub_gate_14c_signal_portfolio_rank_corre.definition: rank correlation between (a) signal-based Top 20 selection and (b) actual realized Top 20 performance rank
sub_gate_14c_signal_portfolio_rank_corre.measurement: monthly cross-section Spearman rank corr → average
sub_gate_14c_signal_portfolio_rank_corre.hard_fail: rank_corr < 0.05 → signal quality은 있으나 portfolio translation 완전 실패
sub_gate_14c_signal_portfolio_rank_corre.rationale: signal high-ranked 종목이 actual return도 상위면 translation 작동. 낮으면 signal-portfolio decoupling.

gate_14_aggregate_verdict.all_pass: 3 sub-gates 모두 PASS → Signal-Portfolio Translation VALIDATED → S6 진입 + Governor PG1 admission 가능
gate_14_aggregate_verdict.conditional: 1+ sub-gate CONDITIONAL + 0 hard_fail → S5 mutation 의무 (overlay 또는 N_HOLD 조정)
gate_14_aggregate_verdict.hard_fail_any: 1+ sub-gate hard_fail → Signal-Portfolio Translation Failure family 3rd member 확정 → VALIDATED_HARD_FAIL 즉시 태깅 + Governor AX_CAND_signal_portfolio_translation_failure 3/3 promote trigger
gate_14_aggregate_verdict.grade_decision_impact: hard_fail 발생 시 Grade F 자동 + Admission Rule v3.5.2 mandatory hard fail 추가 (MDD>45%, TO>600% 다음 3번째 absolute reject)

multi_sleeve_test.purpose: multi-sleeve 내 H_1693의 defense contribution 측정 (core MDD 완화 + crisis alpha)
multi_sleeve_test.expected_result: gate 14 sub_gates + AX-001 v2 4-gate 동시 측정

h_1693_gate_14_multi_sleeve_bypass_path.condition: standalone gate 14 CONDITIONAL (not hard_fail) + multi_sleeve AX-001 v2 4-gate ALL PASS (crisis_alpha > 0 + bad/normal IC ratio > 0.6 + core MDD reduction ≥ 10%)
h_1693_gate_14_multi_sleeve_bypass_path.verdict: H_1693 Defense admission 가능 (Grade B or Grade A depending on total)
h_1693_gate_14_multi_sleeve_bypass_path.rationale: AX-001 v2 철학: Defense는 전기간 SR/CAGR/MDD 아닌 multi-sleeve 내 기여로 평가. Gate 14 standalone CONDITIONAL은 multi-sleeve context에서 overlay/다른 sleeve 보완 가능.
